title: Cohort Discovery Service collection
description: Descriptive metadata for a collection that can be queried through the Cohort Discovery Service.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What the collection is and where to find out more.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name researchers see in query results.

description.title: Description
description.description: A short account of who is in the collection and how the data were gathered.
description.guidance: Two or three sentences. Researchers read this before deciding whether to apply for access.

url.title: External link
url.description: A page elsewhere with more about the collection, such as its Gateway dataset page.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Terms that help researchers find the collection.

contactPoint.title: Contact email
contactPoint.description: A team mailbox for questions about the collection.
contactPoint.guidance: Use a shared team address rather than a named person's email.

coverage.title: Coverage
coverage.description: Who and what period the collection covers.

population.title: Population
examples: Adults registered with a GP in Scotland

access.title: Access
access.description: How a researcher gets access once they have found a cohort.

howToApply.title: How to apply
howToApply.description: The steps a researcher takes to request access.

accessRights.title: Access rights
accessRights.description: A page setting out the terms of access.

landingPage.title: Landing page
landingPage.description: Extra content shown on the collection's page in Cohort Discovery.

about.title: About
about.description: A longer introduction to the collection.
